lines.text: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus and an apostle, writes of the gospel God promised through His prophets.
God's Son was a descendant of Saul and was declared the Son of God by His resurrection from the dead.
Paul greets those in Rome with grace and peace and thanks God because their faith is proclaimed all over the world.
Paul prays constantly to visit Rome, but he has been prevented from coming until now.
Paul is not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation, and the righteous will live by works.
